source.name: IEX Historical Data (TOPS)
source.disclaimer: Venue-specific IEX reference price; not a consolidated closing price.

methodology.referencePrice: The last eligible trade on IEX in the final 30 minutes of the regular session (measured back from the session-end event, so a half day is judged against its own close). Eligible: not an odd lot, not extended hours, not broken. Never interpolated.

quality.H: HIGH: at least 100 eligible IEX trades and $1,000,000 IEX dollar volume that day, 10 trades in the final half hour, the last within 5 minutes of the close
quality.U: USABLE: at least 20 eligible IEX trades and $100,000, 3 in the final half hour, the last inside it
quality.unavailable: Anything less, a latest observation more than 2 trading days old (stale), or an unconfirmed move of more than 40% on a USABLE day (discontinuity): no reference price

methodology.week52: High and low of the daily IEX reference prices over the last 252 trading days, adjusted for confirmed splits to the latest share basis, stated only when 80% of those days have one and the whole window lies on or after historyValidFrom
methodology.changes: Latest reference price over the one 21 (1m), 63 (3m), 126 (6m), 252 (12m) trading days earlier (nearest within 3 days), each base published with its date
methodology.volatility: Sample standard deviation of daily log returns between consecutive trading days, times the square root of 252; 63 returns (3m) and 252 (12m), each with the count of returns behind it
methodology.drawdown: Largest fall from a running peak to a later trough within the 52 weeks, both published with their dates
methodology.splits: Confirmed only: an overnight change over 40% is a candidate, and earlier prices are rescaled only when the company's SEC filing states a split or reverse split whose ratio the move matches within 15% (and the cover share counts, where available, do not contradict it), at the filing's ratio
methodology.corporateActions: Every candidate is classified CONFIRMED_SPLIT, CONFIRMED_REVERSE_SPLIT, OTHER_CORPORATE_ACTION, UNRESOLVED, ORDINARY_PRICE_MOVE on the company's own SEC filings, with the form, accession and link published. A spin-off, distribution, special dividend, reclassification or reorganisation (OTHER), or a split-shaped move no filing explains (UNRESOLVED), is never rescaled: historyValidFrom is its date, and every figure whose window starts before it is withheld until enough history after it exists
